checklist.title: Bypass bundle size limit validation by submitting calls exceeding wallet maximum
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the wallet's bundle size limit (e.g., MAX_CALLS_PER_BUNDLE). 2. Construct a wallet_sendCalls request with exactly MAX+1 calls. 3. Submit and verify the wallet rejects with an appropriate error. 4. Test edge cases: exactly MAX calls (should succeed), 0 calls, negative/non-integer count if applicable. 5. Verify no partial execution occurs when the limit is exceeded.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP5792-PRECOND-008. Covers ACTION-VALIDATE-BUNDLE-SIZE, STATE-VALIDATION-FAILED. Pre-condition falsification: attempt to bypass the bundle size gate.

checklist.title: Verify ecrecover output format: recovered address must be left-padded to 32 bytes
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call ecrecover with known valid (v, r, s) and message hash where the expected address is known. 2. Verify the returned 32-byte output has exactly 12 leading zero bytes followed by the 20-byte address. 3. Test with addresses that have leading zero nibbles to ensure padding is correct. 4. Verify the output length is exactly 32 bytes, not 20.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ECRECOVER-POSTCOND-001. Covers STATE-KEY-RECOVERED, ACTION-DERIVE-ADDRESS, ACTION-PAD-ADDRESS, STATE-ECRECOVER-SUCCESS. Post-condition: verify side effects match specification.

checklist.title: Violate zero-padding invariant by supplying short input to ecrecover
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call ecrecover with input shorter than 128 bytes (e.g., 64 bytes, 1 byte, 0 bytes). 2. Verify the implementation right-pads with zeros before parsing v, r, s. 3. Compare the result against calling with the explicitly zero-padded 128-byte input. 4. Both calls must produce identical results. 5. Test boundary: exactly 128 bytes (no padding needed).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ECRECOVER-INV-003. Covers STATE-ECRECOVER-CALLED, ACTION-PARSE-INPUT. Related ambiguity: AMB-CANCUN-ECRECOVER-01. Invariant falsification: attempt to violate zero-padding through truncated inputs.

checklist.title: Bypass sequential validation by providing invalid v with valid r,s to ecrecover
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Supply v outside {27,28} range with valid r and s. Verify recovery fails. 2. Supply valid v but r=0. Verify recovery fails. 3. Supply valid v, valid r, but s=0. Verify recovery fails. 4. Supply all invalid (v,r,s). Verify graceful failure (empty return, no revert). 5. Confirm no key recovery is attempted when any check fails.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ECRECOVER-PRECOND-005. Covers STATE-INPUT-VALID, STATE-INPUT-PARSED. Pre-condition falsification: bypass sequential validation gates.

checklist.title: Verify activated validator transitions correctly to active status with attestation eligibility
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a valid validator deposit and wait for activation epoch. 2. Verify the validator's status transitions to 'active'. 3. Confirm the validator appears in the active validator set for the correct epoch. 4. Verify the validator is eligible for attestation duties. 5. Check that activation_epoch is correctly set and the validator cannot attest before it.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7514-POSTCOND-002. Covers ACTION-ACTIVATE-VALIDATOR, STATE-VALIDATOR-ACTIVE. Post-condition verification of state transition correctness.

checklist.title: Exploit asymmetric entry/exit to manipulate validator set via coordinated exits and re-entries
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Simulate a scenario where a large fraction of validators exit simultaneously. 2. Compute the churn limit for exits vs entries under EIP-7514 caps. 3. Verify that re-entry after mass exit is rate-limited and cannot reconstitute a majority faster than honest validators can respond. 4. Check that the activation queue respects MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT. 5. Model the worst-case time for an attacker to regain 1/3 of the validator set.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7514-INV-005. Covers ACTION-MASS-EXIT-SCENARIO, ACTION-EVALUATE-CONSENSUS-IMPACT. Related assumption: ASSUM-EIP7514-03. Invariant falsification: attempt to exploit entry/exit asymmetry.

checklist.title: Verify call depth increments by exactly one per nested call within recursion limit
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Deploy a contract that recursively calls itself and logs the call depth at each level. 2. Execute and verify depth increments by exactly 1 per call. 3. Test at depth 1023 (should succeed) and 1024 (should fail). 4. Verify the failing call does not corrupt the caller's state. 5. Confirm gas accounting is correct at maximum depth.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EVMINIT-POSTCOND-001. Covers STATE-WITHIN-LIMIT, STATE-CALL-DEPTH-INCREMENTED. Post-condition: verify depth counter side-effect.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-SEND-BLOCK: block size validation against MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE before processing
checklist.bug_class: Denial of Service via oversized payload
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. From an external peer node, send a block with RLP-encoded size exactly 8,388,608 bytes (MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE). Verify it is accepted. 2. Send a block with RLP-encoded size 8,388,609 bytes. Verify it is rejected before any expensive deserialization occurs. 3. Measure resource consumption: the rejecting node must not allocate memory proportional to the oversized payload. 4. Send a malformed RLP payload claiming a valid size but containing garbage. Verify the node rejects gracefully. 5. Verify the check occurs at the P2P layer before passing to block processing.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7934-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge: EDGE-PEER-SEND-BLOCK from EXT-PEER-NODE-VIA-P2P to Execution Layer (EL) via P2P devp2p / etha block propagation. Related ambiguity: AMB-EIP7934-01.

checklist.title: Verify internal RLP encoding produces correct size measurement for boundary validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Take a known block and RLP-encode it. Verify the encoded size matches expected value. 2. Test with blocks containing maximum-size transactions. 3. Verify the size measurement is performed on the canonical RLP encoding, not a re-encoding. 4. Confirm no off-by-one in size comparison.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7934-PRECOND-001. Supporting node check for boundary edge EDGE-PEER-SEND-BLOCK. Verifies internal logic supporting the boundary guard.

checklist.title: Violate the 2 MiB safety margin between EL max block size and CL limit
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a block at exactly MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE (8 MiB). 2. Calculate the CL wrapper overhead (SSZ encoding, beacon block fields). 3. Verify 8 MiB + overhead < ~10 MiB CL limit. 4. Attempt to craft a block that, after CL wrapping, exceeds the CL gossip limit. 5. Verify the 2 MiB margin is sufficient under worst-case overhead assumptions.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7934-INV-002. Covers STATE-CONSENSUS-LAYER-PROTECTED. Related: AMB-EIP7934-02, ASSUM-EIP7934-01. Invariant falsification: attempt to violate cross-layer safety margin.

checklist.title: Verify etha protocol connection is fully established and operational after handshake
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Perform a valid etha handshake between two nodes. 2. Verify both nodes transition to connected state. 3. Send a data request immediately after handshake completes. 4. Verify data exchange succeeds without additional negotiation. 5. Test that a half-completed handshake does not result in a connected state.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7801-POSTCOND-001. Covers STATE-HANDSHAKE-VALID, STATE-ETHA-CONNECTED. Post-condition: verify connection readiness.

checklist.title: Exploit all-zero bitmask nodes that consume data without contributing availability
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Configure a node with an all-zero era bitmask. 2. Verify the node does not serve any historical data requests. 3. Verify the node can still request and receive data from peers. 4. Assess whether a majority of zero-bitmask nodes would degrade network data availability. 5. Check if peers can detect and deprioritize zero-bitmask free-riders.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7801-INV-003. Covers STATE-BITMASK-UNSET, ACTION-SET-BITMASK. Related: AMB-EIP7801-01. Invariant falsification: exploit zero-bitmask for free-riding.

checklist.title: Violate access set initialization by checking for missing precompile or sender addresses
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Start a transaction and immediately check accessed_addresses before any SLOAD/CALL. 2. Verify sender address is in accessed_addresses. 3. Verify recipient (to) address is in accessed_addresses. 4. Verify all precompile addresses (0x01-0x0a for post-Cancun) are in accessed_addresses. 5. Verify no other addresses are present. 6. Test with contract creation tx (no recipient) to verify correct handling.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2929-INV-001. Covers STATE-TX-EXECUTION-START, ACTION-INITIALIZE-ACCESS-SETS, STATE-ACCESS-SETS-READY. Invariant falsification: attempt to find missing entries in initial access set.

checklist.title: Verify cold SSTORE adds storage key to accessed set and subsequent access is warm
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute SSTORE to a previously unaccessed (address, storage_key) pair. 2. Verify cold access gas cost is charged (2100 + write cost). 3. Immediately SLOAD the same key. 4. Verify warm access gas cost is charged (100). 5. Verify the storage key persists in accessed_storage_keys for the transaction lifetime. 6. Test that a revert removes the key from the accessed set.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2929-POSTCOND-002. Covers ACTION-ADD-STORAGE-KEY-TO-SET, STATE-STORAGE-WRITTEN. Post-condition: verify access set mutation.

checklist.title: Verify pre-warmed address results in warm gas cost (100) during sub-call
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Use an access list (EIP-2930) to pre-warm an address. 2. Execute a CALL to that address within the transaction. 3. Verify the CALL charges only 100 gas for the address access (warm cost). 4. Compare against a call to a non-pre-warmed address to confirm cold cost difference. 5. Verify pre-warming persists across nested calls.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2929-POSTCOND-005. Covers ACTION-PRE-WARM-ACCESS, STATE-CALL-SUCCEEDS-WARM. Related: ASSUM-EIP2929-03. Post-condition: verify warm access cost after pre-warming.

checklist.title: Violate PUSH0 invariant: must push exactly 0 and consume exactly 2 gas
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute PUSH0 and verify the top of stack is exactly 0 (not uninitialized, not 1). 2. Verify stack depth increased by exactly 1. 3. Measure gas consumed: must be exactly 2 (Gbase). 4. Compare gas cost against PUSH1 0x00 (which costs 3). 5. Execute PUSH0 at max stack depth (1024 items) and verify stack overflow error.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP3855-INV-001. Covers STATE-PUSH0-DECODED, ACTION-PUSH-ZERO, ACTION-DEDUCT-GAS, STATE-PUSH0-COMPLETE. Invariant falsification: attempt to get non-zero value or incorrect gas.

checklist.title: Verify opcode 0x5f behavior differs before and after EIP-3855 fork activation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. On a pre-Shanghai chain config, execute bytecode containing opcode 0x5f. 2. Verify execution fails with invalid opcode error. 3. On a post-Shanghai chain config, execute the same bytecode. 4. Verify execution succeeds and 0 is pushed to stack. 5. Test at the exact fork boundary block.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP3855-INV-003. Covers STATE-PRE-FORK, STATE-POST-FORK, ACTION-INVALID-OPCODE-ERROR, ACTION-EXECUTE-PUSH0. Invariant falsification: attempt to use PUSH0 before activation.

checklist.title: Violate Keccak512 determinism by hashing identical inputs and comparing outputs
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Hash a known input with Keccak512 and record the 64-byte output. 2. Hash the same input again and verify byte-for-byte identical output. 3. Repeat 1000 times with random inputs to detect any non-determinism. 4. Compare against known Keccak512 test vectors. 5. Test with empty input, single byte, and large (1MB) input.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-HASH-INV-002. Covers full Keccak512 pipeline. Related: ASSUM-CRYPTO-HASH-03. Invariant falsification: attempt to produce different outputs for same input.

checklist.title: Verify Keccak primitive correctness against reference implementation and known collision resistance
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Run the full NIST Keccak test vector suite for both Keccak256 and Keccak512. 2. Verify all test vectors pass. 3. Confirm the implementation uses the standard Keccak (not SHA-3 with domain separation). 4. Verify no known collisions exist in the implementation's output space. 5. Check that the library version is up-to-date and has no known CVEs.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-HASH-INV-004. Covers ACTION-CREATE-KECCAK256-OBJECT, ACTION-CREATE-KECCAK512-OBJECT. Related: ASSUM-CRYPTO-HASH-01. Invariant falsification: attempt to find primitive weakness.

checklist.title: Verify transactions exceeding per-transaction gas cap (16,777,216) are rejected from mempool
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a transaction with gasLimit = 16,777,216. Verify it is accepted to mempool. 2. Submit a transaction with gasLimit = 16,777,217. Verify it is rejected. 3. Verify the rejection occurs at mempool admission, not during block building. 4. Check error message indicates gas limit exceeded. 5. Verify the transaction is not propagated to peers.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7825-POSTCOND-002. Covers STATE-GAS-LIMIT-EXCEEDED, ACTION-REJECT-TX, STATE-TX-REJECTED. Post-condition: verify rejection side-effect.

checklist.title: Verify block total gas can exceed per-tx cap via multiple sub-cap transactions
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a block with multiple transactions each under 16,777,216 gas but totaling more than 16,777,216. 2. Verify the block is valid and accepted. 3. Verify each individual transaction passes the per-tx gas cap check independently. 4. Confirm block gas limit is governed by the standard block gas limit mechanism, not the per-tx cap.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7825-INV-002. Covers STATE-BLOCK-ACCEPTED. Related: AMB-EIP7825-03. Invariant falsification: attempt to reject a valid block due to aggregate gas confusion.

checklist.title: Verify seed hash computation produces correct 64-byte value from header_hash and nonce
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Take a known block header hash and nonce. 2. Reverse the nonce bytes. 3. Compute keccak512(header_hash || reversed_nonce). 4. Verify the result is exactly 64 bytes. 5. Compare against known Ethash test vectors. 6. Verify the seed hash correctly initializes the mix array (first 32 bytes = mix[0..15] as uint32 LE).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ETHASH-POSTCOND-001. Covers ACTION-COMPUTE-SEED-HASH, STATE-SEED-HASH-READY. Post-condition: verify correct seed derivation.

checklist.title: Violate epoch transition invariant: transitions must occur every 30,000 blocks
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Compute epoch number for blocks 0, 29999, 30000, 30001, 59999, 60000. 2. Verify epoch(0)=epoch(29999)=0, epoch(30000)=epoch(59999)=1, epoch(60000)=2. 3. Verify cache and dataset parameters change at each epoch boundary. 4. Test that the seed hash chain is correctly extended at each transition. 5. Verify no off-by-one at the boundary (block 30000 is epoch 1, not epoch 0).
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ETHASH-INV-002. Covers STATE-CURRENT-EPOCH, ACTION-CHECK-EPOCH-BOUNDARY, STATE-EPOCH-BOUNDARY-CROSSED. Related: ASSUM-ETHASH-04. Invariant falsification: attempt to get wrong epoch at boundary.

checklist.title: Assess Ethash memory-hardness: verify dataset access pattern prevents ASIC optimization
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Profile the Ethash hash computation to confirm dataset fetches are the bottleneck. 2. Verify the dataset size grows with epoch as specified (initial ~1GB, growing). 3. Confirm that each hashimoto round accesses pseudo-random dataset rows. 4. Verify the access pattern is not predictable enough to prefetch effectively. 5. Compare computation time with and without full dataset in memory.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ETHASH-INV-005. Covers ACTION-FETCH-DATASET-ROW. Related: ASSUM-ETHASH-01. Invariant: memory-hardness assessment.

checklist.title: Verify light client hashimoto completes all 64 iterations without short-circuiting
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Instrument the light client hashimoto function to count iterations. 2. Run verification on a known block and confirm exactly 64 iterations execute. 3. Verify each iteration generates and returns a dataset item. 4. Compare the final result against full-dataset hashimoto for the same block. 5. Test that early termination does not occur even when intermediate mix values appear 'done'.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ETHASH-POSTCOND-005. Covers ACTION-RETURN-TO-HASHIMOTO, STATE-VERIFICATION-CONTINUES. Post-condition: verify loop completion.
